metadata.title: रायपुर का आदिवासी मेला | Tribal Fest in Raipur, Chhattisgarh | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
National Tribal Dance Festival 2021, Day One: Colorful stage set for dance festival in Chhattisgarh. The three-day festival will witness the participation of teams from Indian tribes as well as by performers from across the world.

#TribalFestivalCG #Chhattisgarh #MainBhiBharat
